text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses land-use modeling (via the AEZ model) as one component within an integrated CLEWS (Climate, Land-use, Energy, Water Systems) framework focused primarily on energy system analysis for Mauritius. While it includes future land-use scenarios (e.g., shifting from sugarcane to alternative crops for ethanol production) and models agricultural land use at national scale with spatial resolution (~250 m), land-use change is not the primary research objective. Instead, LULC is used as an input to assess impacts on energy, water, and emissions. The study implements multiple future scenarios and includes spatially explicit modeling, but its core focus is on demonstrating the added value of interlinking systems from an energy perspective—not on predicting or analyzing LULC change per se. Thus, it meets inclusion criteria only partially and is categorized as 'POSSIBLE'.)
